_description: Pattern-piece assembly (Phase 8): builds a closed 100x100 square outline and wraps it in a piece (piece.addPatternPiece), attaches a label anchor (piece.addAnchorPoint), and adds a diagonal internal path (piece.internalPath).
_note: piece.union is deliberately NOT exercised here. It reproducibly segfaults inside VToolUnion (see docs/action-layer-schema.md's 'piece.union' entry and src/libs/actionlayer/handlers/piece_handlers.h's own KNOWN GAP comment) -- calling it from a script wired into 'make check' would crash the whole test run instead of failing one case cleanly. This is a documented, deliberate coverage gap, not an oversight; remove this note and add piece.union coverage once that crash is root-caused and fixed.
